CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Dualarr** is a companion to **Sonarr** for anime. It checks every anime file's audio and subtitle languages and keeps them in **Japanese with subtitles**, then swaps subbed-only releases for **dual audio** once the English dub comes out.
One click sets up two custom formats in Sonarr (dual audio preferred, dub-only never grabbed); a nightly scan finds files without Japanese audio or subtitles, searches a few series at a time, and can notify you about upgrades and problems.
Setup and caveats: see the [README](https://github.com/jpjoseph12/dualarr#readme). Questions and bugs: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/jpjoseph12/dualarr/issues).
